name: ibis Styles Bali Denpasar
short_description: A 153-room ibis Styles in central Denpasar with a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (88 reviews), positioned for business travellers and easy road access to Seminyak, Sanur, Legian and Kuta.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bali Denpasar is a 153-room design-economy hotel in the heart of Denpasar, Bali's capital and business centre, with easy road access to Seminyak, Sanur, Legian, and Kuta. The hotel holds a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 88 reviews. On-site facilities include the Montana Restaurant and a fitness centre. As an ibis Styles property it carries the brand's design-led, all-inclusive-rate positioning, and standard ALL elite benefits apply for programme members.

core_facts.address: Jl. Teuku Umar No. 183, Denpasar, Bali, 80114, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 153 rooms in central Denpasar — Bali's business and government centre, distinct from the beach-resort towns
Easy road access to Seminyak, Sanur, Legian, and Kuta for travellers who want a business base with beach access nearby
cons: Denpasar itself is not a beach or tourist destination — guests wanting direct beach access should look to Kuta, Legian, or Seminyak instead
Review volume (88) is modest relative to some of Bali's larger Accor properties
research_highlights: Montana Restaurant and fitness centre on-site

source_mix.label: Accor ALL — ibis Styles Bali Denpasar official page
